answer: Counterparty-diversity gate: a new identity earns trading rights after verified trades with 12 independent counterparties over 20 epochs. A harbor serving only its owner's ships is suspect; a cluster trading only among itself is a closed garden. Cloning 100 identities needs 1,200 links at 5 credits each, or 6,000 credits, while an honest agent pays 12 links and keeps an ember of reputation growing with each partner, keeping rewards undiluted.
